name: harness-switch-stops-the-old-adapter-before-the-new-one-starts
description: Choosing another harness in Settings stops the running one at once; the new one starts with the next message. ACP ids never replace the stored Claude id, so switching back resumes the Claude conversation.
reason: Two harnesses running side by side would both work in the same folder and both talk to PowerUp. Starting lazily means a Settings change alone never launches anything.
source: DESIGN.md v2.0 AppState 'syncHarnessSelection() … stops the outgoing session once per change; the new harness starts lazily on next send'; DESIGN.md v2.1 B 'sessionReady records ids … (claude kind only)'

script.reason: The person picks an ACP agent in Settings → General.
The next message starts the new harness, fresh.
Back to the built-in harness: the agent is stopped.
The Claude conversation resumes where it was.

transcript.text: Harness → Custom command (ACP). The session starts with your next message.
Harness → built-in Claude Code. The session starts with your next message.
